driverFormulas.rev: Revenue = Gross Billed Revenue − Credits, Price Concessions & Bad Debt
driverFormulas.cogs: Cost of Sales = Wholesale Access + Interconnect & MVNO + Hardware, Platforms & Network
driverFormulas.gp: Gross Profit = Revenue − Cost of Sales
driverFormulas.gp-pct: Gross Margin % = Gross Profit / Revenue x 100
driverFormulas.opex-excl: Operating Costs = Partner & Sales + Network & IT + People, G&A & Integration
driverFormulas.ebitda: Adjusted EBITDA = Gross Profit − Operating Costs
driverFormulas.ebitda-pct: Adjusted EBITDA Margin % = EBITDA / Revenue x 100
driverFormulas.da: Depreciation & Amortisation = Network + Right-of-Use + Software & Acquired Intangibles
driverFormulas.ebit-pct: Adjusted EBIT Margin % = EBIT / Revenue x 100
driverFormulas.nonop: Net Finance Income & Other = Finance Income − Finance Costs + Other
driverFormulas.ebt: Adjusted Profit Before Tax = EBIT + Net Finance & Other
driverFormulas.ni: Adjusted Profit After Tax = Profit Before Tax − Income Tax
driverFormulas.ni-pct: Net Margin % = Profit After Tax / Revenue x 100
driverFormulas.bs-assets: Total Assets = Current Assets + Non-Current Assets
driverFormulas.bs-ca: Current Assets = Cash + Receivables + Inventory & Accrued Income + Prepaids
driverFormulas.bs-inv: Accrued Income, Contract Assets & Inventory = Unbilled Usage + Contract Assets + Hardware Stock
driverFormulas.bs-nca: Non-Current Assets = PP&E + Accum. Depreciation + Goodwill & Intangibles + Other
driverFormulas.bs-liab-eq: Total Liabilities & Equity = Current Liabilities + Non-Current Liabilities + Equity
driverFormulas.bs-cl: Current Liabilities = Payables + Accruals + ST Debt + Deferred Income
driverFormulas.bs-ncl: Non-Current Liabilities = Leases + Deferred Tax + Provisions & Deferred Consideration
driverFormulas.bs-equity: Equity = Share Capital + Retained Earnings + Other Reserves
driverFormulas.cfo: Cash Flow from Operating Activities = Profit After Tax + D&A + Working Capital
driverFormulas.cfi: Cash Flow from Investing Activities = CapEx + Disposals + Acquisitions
driverFormulas.cff: Cash Flow from Financing Activities = Borrowings + Lease Payments + Dividends
driverFormulas.cf-net: Net Change in Cash = CFO + CFI + CFF
driverFormulas.cf-end-cash: Ending Cash = Net Change + Beginning Cash
